## 📋 Description of Changes
A concise explanation of the bug fixed, skill added, or documentation improved.

## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #[issue-number] (or relates to #[issue-number])

## 🧬 Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 New Skill or Workflow (`feat`)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug Fix (`fix`)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation Update (`docs`)
- [ ] 🧪 Testing Enhancement (`test`)
- [ ] 🔨 Refactoring or Performance Improvement (`refactor`)

## ✅ Contributor Checklist
- [ ] My branch is rebased on latest `main` with 0 conflicts.
- [ ] I have followed the standards in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] If adding or modifying a skill:
  - [ ] YAML frontmatter in `SKILL.md` is valid and contains clear trigger conditions.
  - [ ] Registered in `tests/test-skills.js`.
  - [ ] Follows the Superpowers principle of "Evidence Before Assertion".
- [ ] `npm test` runs cleanly and all tests pass with hard terminal proof:
  ```
  Paste passing npm test output here
  ```
- [ ] Updated `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` if user-facing behavior changed.
